en.headline: DesignInspire opens to public today at Convention and Exhibition Centre
en.dek: The free design exhibition under the Wander and Wonder theme runs until 21 November with over 200 exhibitors from 17 countries.
body: The Hong Kong Trade Development Council said DesignInspire opens to the public today at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai.

Admission is free via registration. The exhibition runs from 19 to 21 November, with hours from 9:30 am to 7:30 pm on Thursday and Friday and until 7 pm on Saturday. It was open to trade visitors on Wednesday.

Under the theme Wander and Wonder, organisers said the event brings together more than 200 exhibitors from 17 countries and regions, featuring interactive exhibits, design projects and workshops that link design with culture and everyday life. Highlight programmes include Cabinets of Wonders curated by a Hong Kong artist, Breathing in Motion by a Swiss studio, ABITO/HK presented by Salone del Mobile Milano, and House of Lumiere by local lighting designers.

The Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law welcomed the launch of related design events including Business of Design Week, saying they demonstrate Hong Kong's advantages in connecting global creative talent and promoting cross-cultural exchange.

zh.headline: DesignInspire創意設計博覽今日開放公眾參觀
zh.dek: 以Wander & Wonder為主題的免費設計展覽於灣仔會展舉行至11月21日，匯聚17個國家及地區逾200個參展商。
body: 香港貿易發展局表示，DesignInspire創意設計博覽今日起開放公眾參觀，地點在灣仔香港會議展覽中心。
入場免費，需登記。展覽由11月19日至21日舉行，星期四及五上午9時30分至晚上7時30分，星期六至晚上7時。周三則只開放予商貿買家。
今屆以Wander & Wonder為主題，主辦方指匯聚來自17個國家及地區逾200個參展商，透過互動展品、設計項目及工作坊，連結設計與文化及日常生活。焦點包括香港藝術家策劃的Cabinets of Wonders、瑞士工作室的Breathing in Motion、米蘭國際家具展呈獻的ABITO/HK，以及本地燈光設計師的House of Lumière。
文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩歡迎相關設計活動包括設計營商周的啟動，表示這些活動展現香港連繫全球創意人才及促進跨文化交流的優勢。
